_doc: The injection.log DROPPED line (KeystrokeInjector.injectionLogLine, QuipMac/Services/KeystrokeInjector.swift), without the leading ISO-8601 timestamp the writer adds. input: op, window, app (iTerm2 | Terminal | Claude, or null for none), kind (sessionNotFound | tccDenied | windowClosed | unknown, or null = unclassified), message, detail ('' = absent), redact (true = message and non-empty detail pass through SecretRedactor first, as logInjectionFailure does when it writes the file). expect: the line. Format: 'DROPPED op=<token> window=<token> app=<app or -> kind=<kind> msg="<value>"' plus ' detail="<value>"' when detail is non-empty. A token is the text split on Unicode whitespace and newlines, empty pieces dropped, joined with '_'; empty result is '-'. A value escapes, in this order, backslash to \\, quote to \", LF to \n, CR to \r; nothing else is escaped. Expected values are written by the Swift test (QUIP_WRITE_VECTORS=1), never by hand.

cases.expect: DROPPED op=sendText window=w-1a2b3c app=iTerm2 kind=sessionNotFound msg="session not yet mapped for window w-1a2b3c"

input.message: session not yet mapped for window w-1a2b3c
